_readme: Spoken scripts and synthesis settings. Only 'text' is sent to the TTS service; 'direction' is for choosing a voice and judging takes (never spoken). voice_id/model_id stay null until chosen from the account's real voice/model lists (scripts/voiceover.py voices|models). Pronunciation of 'Privilee' is unverified against an official spoken reference — audition and note the result in audio/narration/*.meta.json.
direction: Warm, grounded, conversational adult male narrator. Clear international English, relaxed confident delivery, natural breathing, subtle smile. Lightly energetic over gym passages, calmer over pool/beach. Short natural pauses after complete thoughts. 'Different cities. Same routine.' assured and personal. Clear pronunciation of Privilee, UAE, Qatar and any price. Understated — no trailer or sales-announcer delivery.

vo_main.text:
Different cities. Same routine.

My work takes me across the UAE, and Privilee has been my best life hack since moving to Dubai.

Different gyms keep things interesting, and having options around my day helps me stay consistent.

There are options in Qatar and Oman too.

Then at the weekend, I can slow down by the pool or at the beach.

For me, that's the best part: keeping up with training, and still making time to switch off.

vo_white_friday.text:
Here's my best life hack since moving to Dubai.

My work takes me all over the UAE… so I open Privilee and find a place to train around my day.

Different gyms keep it interesting. And having options is what keeps me consistent.

Weights one day. Muay Thai the next.

And with eligible memberships, it even works in Qatar and Oman.

Then the weekend comes… and I slow down by the pool, or at the beach.

Different cities. Same routine.

The White Friday Edit is a UAE-only offer: three months for AED 1,899.
